description.value:
Duration constant

You started this fight already carrying what the last one did to you.

You begin every encounter with Tally equal to half the Tally you were holding when your previous encounter ended, rounded down, to a maximum of 3. This is the only way Tally has ever crossed from one fight into the next, and it is why nobody has ever seen you start one fresh.

cinderfall.incomplete: Start each encounter with half of the previous encounter's leftover Tally, capped at 3. Deadhand's Tally is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus.
